## Problem and result

Describe the real question, resulting behavior and relevant input.

## Scope and authority

Identify the bounded grant, limits and consequential stop.

## Validation

human, configuration and hosted evidence. Preserve findings and unavailable checks.

## AI assistance

Disclose tools used, what they contributed, and how you reviewed their output.

By submitting, confirm you can explain the change and follow CONTRIBUTING.md,
